description: Governance assessment template for organizations using AI systems for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) monitoring, reporting, and decision-making.

domains.name: Environmental AI Governance
domains.description: Governance of AI systems used for environmental monitoring, carbon tracking, climate risk modeling, and sustainability reporting.

controls.name: Environmental Data Quality
controls.description: Ensure AI systems processing environmental data use validated, traceable, and auditable data sources.

controls.name: Carbon & Emissions AI Accuracy
controls.description: Validate accuracy and reliability of AI models used for carbon footprint calculation and emissions tracking.

controls.name: Climate Risk Model Governance
controls.description: Govern AI-based climate risk models including scenario analysis, validation, and uncertainty disclosure.

controls.name: AI System Environmental Footprint
controls.description: Monitor and report the environmental impact (energy consumption, carbon footprint) of AI systems themselves.

domains.name: Social AI Governance
domains.description: Governance of AI systems used for social impact assessment, workforce analytics, diversity monitoring, and community engagement.

controls.name: Bias and Fairness in Social AI
controls.description: Assess and mitigate bias in AI systems used for workforce analytics, hiring, and social impact measurement.

controls.name: Privacy in Social Data Processing
controls.description: Ensure AI systems handling social data (employee, community, health) comply with privacy regulations and ethical standards.

controls.name: Human Rights Impact Assessment
controls.description: Conduct AI-specific human rights impact assessments for systems affecting communities and stakeholders.

controls.name: Stakeholder Transparency
controls.description: Provide transparent disclosures about AI use in social impact measurement and decision-making.

domains.name: Governance of AI in ESG Reporting
domains.description: Oversight, accountability, and governance structures for AI systems used in ESG reporting and compliance.

controls.name: AI ESG Reporting Accountability
controls.description: Define clear accountability structures for AI-driven ESG reporting outputs and decisions.

controls.name: Regulatory Compliance Alignment
controls.description: Ensure AI-based ESG monitoring aligns with applicable regulations (EU CSRD, SEC climate rules, TCFD, etc.).

controls.name: AI Model Auditability
controls.description: Maintain audit trails and explainability for AI models used in ESG scoring and rating.

controls.name: Third-Party AI Vendor Governance
controls.description: Govern third-party AI tools and vendors used for ESG data collection, analysis, and reporting.

domains.name: ESG Data Integration & AI Pipeline
domains.description: Governance of data pipelines and integration points where AI processes ESG-related information.

controls.name: ESG Data Pipeline Integrity
controls.description: Ensure integrity, completeness, and consistency of data flowing through AI-powered ESG pipelines.

controls.name: Cross-Domain Data Reconciliation
controls.description: Validate consistency of AI outputs across environmental, social, and governance data domains.

controls.name: Continuous Monitoring and Alerting
controls.description: Implement AI-driven continuous monitoring with alerts for ESG metric anomalies and threshold breaches.
